source.description: Pre-extraction monolithic page renderers (the parent of d208b5b, the Phase 3 extraction commit).
source.generator: One-time harness: `git archive f2282b7 packages/adapter-canvas/src` extracted to a scratch tree, then each case state rendered by that tree's pages.ts and projected with test/support/pages/compatibility-projection.ts under the repository's own Vitest transform. Regenerate by repeating those steps with the case states stored here; never by rendering current modules.
source.projection: projectPage() keeps title, active top-nav page, in-order navigation targets, in-order markup ids/names/roles, disabled element ids, the values of an allowlisted set of state-carrying elements (graph-repo, diff-repo-select, target-repo, env-name-input, deploy-branch-select, az-app-name-input) as ordered id/value entries, the active secondary navigation targets read from rad-subtab--active (data-page, else data-subtab, else href), normalized visible/hidden state for the pane-environments and pane-credentials panes, status banner id+class+text, in-order unique /api paths, the case's markers as indices in document order, serialized initial-state literals, removed-token hits, and SHA-256 digests of named inline script payloads. Whole pages, snapshots and generated JavaScript are deliberately not stored.
source.hostileInputs: Hostile inputs are excluded on purpose: PU-02 intentionally hardened HTML, JavaScript-string, JSON and URL encoding after this commit, so legacy output for hostile state is a known-bad oracle. Hostile behaviour is covered by the current hostile-input suites instead.
excludedScriptPayloads: graph — CLIENT_GRAPH_JS changed after this commit by upstream #367 (navigation cancel hook clearing window.__radiusDiffTimeout).

page (planned, graph-diff) — the planned runPlan and diff queueDiff/runDiff payloads changed after this commit by upstream #367 (stale-DOM guards); their semantics are still compared through the projection fields.

page (resolved graph states) — PR #379 review replaced the modeled-graph branch status interpolation with textContent to close a reachable DOM-injection path; the stable markup, state and request semantics remain compared through the projection fields.
source.updatePolicy: This fixture is a reviewed compatibility decision. Do not regenerate it from current renderers and do not edit expected values to make a test pass: change it only with an explicit, reviewed compatibility change that explains why legacy behaviour is intentionally no longer preserved.
intentionalDivergences: environment, credentials — the environment creation form became a two-step wizard (choose or create a credential profile, then create the environment), because a credential profile only ever exists in service of an environment. The Credentials sub-tab keeps its own standalone create/edit path, since clicking New Credential Profile expresses intent to manage a credential rather than to create an environment. The change is additive to the legacy projection: no legacy id, marker, navigation target, state value, pane visibility or /api path was removed. The recorded contentIds, the newly disabled env-step1-next step gate, and the page script digest were re-recorded for the environment and credentials cases to accept the added wizard elements.
